name: Loystar for WooCommerce
author: Loystar

sections.description:
The Loystar for WooCommerce plugin seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with the Loystar loyalty and retail platform. It connects your online store with your in-store sales, transactions, customer records, and loyalty programs in one unified place.

Key Features

  • Omni-Channel Loyalty: Reward customers for repeat purchases both online and in-store.
  • Two-Way Order Status Sync: Real-time bi-directional synchronization between WooCommerce and Loystar Online Orders. Statuses (processing, ready, paid, cancelled) stay synchronized instantly.
  • Real-Time Product & Inventory Sync: Import products from Loystar to WooCommerce, or export WooCommerce catalog to Loystar with high-resolution image support and duplicate prevention.
  • Zero-Config App Marketplace Integration: Automatically synchronizes store webhook credentials and ecommerce settings with Loystar.
  • Customer Loyalty Widget & My Account Integration: Customers can view their loyalty points, stamps, and rewards directly on their account dashboard and via the embedded widget.
  • Flexible Checkout Integration: Optional birthday and gender collection at checkout to power automated birthday SMS/email marketing.
  • HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables).

Create your Loystar Account

Don’t have an account? Sign up at https://loystar.co.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the Loystar service to synchronize customer, order, and product data. Please review Loystar’s privacy policy at https://loystar.co/privacy to understand how your data is handled.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the Loystar API service (https://api.loystar.co, https://mtier2.loystar.co, and https://sell.loystar.co) to provide omni-channel loyalty and order sync functionality. By using this plugin, you agree to Loystar’s terms of service available at https://loystar.co/terms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder loystar-woocommerce-loyalty-program to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Loystar Settings in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your Loystar merchant email and password to connect your store.
  5. Select your loyalty program, configure your target ecommerce branch, and enable two-way sync.
sections.faq:
Do my customers need to download a separate mobile app?

No. Online customers simply earn rewards through your WooCommerce checkout. They can track their rewards balance directly in their WooCommerce My Account dashboard or on the store’s loyalty widget.

Does this support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin fully declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (Custom Order Tables).

How does Two-Way Order Status Sync work?

When an order is placed on WooCommerce, it is immediately streamed to your Loystar dashboard. When staff fulfill, mark as ready, or cancel the order in Loystar, the status update is delivered back to WooCommerce via secure webhooks.

Can I import my existing Loystar inventory into WooCommerce?

Yes. You can import products, categories, variants, and stock levels from Loystar into WooCommerce with live progress tracking, as well as export WooCommerce products to Loystar.
